name: claims-scope-2026-10-19
description: 论断“范围错配”评测：引句给出的是总体或其他条件下的结果，论断却限定了某个子类（文献类型、人群、学科、时间、硬件、地区、统计单位等）。检查判定会不会因此误判“与证据矛盾”或“证据支持”，以及范围复核会不会把真正的矛盾、支持错改。
method: 真实部分：三篇 CC BY 论文只用摘要（评测时按 DOI 从 Crossref / OpenAlex 实时获取，与产品在全文取不到时的路径相同），论断由评测者对照摘要编写。合成部分：评测者编写的英文结果段落，开头注明是软件测试用的合成材料、不描述真实研究；论断以中文为主，S6 为英文。expected 列出可接受的结论；论断套用总体数字到子类时，“证据不足”和“部分支持”都算对。

documents.text: Synthetic test material for software testing; it does not describe a real study. In a randomized trial of 600 adults with hypertension, 12% of participants in the drug group reported dizziness, compared with 5% in the placebo group. Among drug-group participants aged 65 or older, 21% reported dizziness. After 12 weeks, systolic blood pressure in the drug group had fallen by an average of 9 mmHg.

Synthetic test material for software testing; it does not describe a real study. In the 2022 school year, an after-school tutoring program in 40 middle schools raised average mathematics scores by 6 points compared with matched schools. In the program's rural schools, the gain was 9 points. Reading scores did not change.

Synthetic test material for software testing; it does not describe a real report. The national unemployment rate fell from 7.5% in 2020 to 5.1% in 2022. Among workers aged 16 to 24, unemployment remained above 12% in every year from 2020 to 2022.

Synthetic test material for software testing; it does not describe a real paper. Across all 12 test languages, the translation model reached an average BLEU score of 31.2. For the four low-resource languages, the average BLEU score was 18.4. Inference took 120 ms per sentence on a single GPU.

Synthetic test material for software testing; it does not describe a real study. In a survey of 8,000 adults in four countries (A, B, C and D), 64% said they intended to get the seasonal flu vaccine. Intention was highest in Country A (78%) and lowest in Country D (49%).

Synthetic test material for software testing; it does not describe a real study. In a 2021 survey of 2,400 hospital nurses, 31% reported symptoms of burnout. Among nurses who regularly worked night shifts, 44% reported burnout.

categories.contra-same: 同一范围的真矛盾：复核不能改掉
categories.contra-subgroup-reported: 原文单独报告了该子类，数字与论断矛盾：复核不能改掉
categories.contra-inferred: 需要推理才能看出的矛盾（“三门考试都”包含 Step 1；A 国最高 78%，B 国就不可能 90%）
categories.support-subgroup-reported: 原文单独报告了该子类，数字与论断一致
categories.narrower-different: 原文没有该子类，论断数字与总体不同：应为证据不足，判定容易误判矛盾
categories.narrower-same-number: 原文没有该子类，论断套用总体数字：应为证据不足或部分支持，判定容易误判支持
categories.time-condition: 时间、硬件条件与原文不同
categories.other-population: 论断说的是另一类对象
